messages:
rachel_partnerships: FYI vendor onboarding for SiliconLine stuck on GCP Marketplace. Procurement says SiliconLine only accepts EDI invoicing and NET60 via their distributor, marketplace requires marketplace-collects and immediate settlement. Also vendor alias doesn't match our vendor registry so PO routing fails. Can partnerships help coordinate?
devon_salesops: Ugh. Do we have the marketplace ticket?
rachel_partnerships: Ticket `MP-992233` and distributor thread `DTR-4432`. Marketplace responded: 
``nSettlement: marketplace-collects only (no off-platform EDI)
Vendor alias mismatch -> invoices rejected on our backend PO router
``n
marta_finance: If we try to accept EDI from SiliconLine we'd need to map their vendor ID to our GL and ensure tax withholding. NET60 is ok if buyer provides a PO, but marketplace listing won't go live without settlement alignment.
lee_legal: Quick flags: SiliconLine wants a warranty carveout and indemnity cap higher than our standard MSA. That's a contract redline. If we're bending payment flow, need a signed SOW or addendum explicitly limiting warranty exposure.
arjun_eng: On the PO routing side, if vendor alias mismatches we can add an alias mapping in the billing pipeline. Small infra change: 2 developer-hours + a DB migration for alias table. Need to coordinate with billing ops.
siliconline_vendor: (from vendor) We can accept marketplace-collects if SiliconLine's distributor provides a bridging PO number. Distributor insists on EDI though. Can Redwood act as a pass-through?
devon_salesops: Distributor bridging will still produce invoices to their vendor id, marketplace rejects off-platform invoices. We need a workaround: either alias mapping on our end or temporary Redwood collection.
marta_finance: Temporary Redwood collection would change revenue/commission flows and may trigger distributor fees. Need a cost/commission calc.
lee_legal: Also will need to sign a limited addendum for collection + carveout on warranty. I won't approve open-ended indemnities.
marketplace_bot: Ticket `MP-992233` update: "Partner Payments team reviewing distributor bridging options; awaiting legal confirmation for tertiary routing."
rachel_partnerships: Proposal: (1) arjun_eng implement alias mapping to unblock PO routing (2) marta_finance run cost/commission delta for temporary collection (3) lee_legal draft narrow addendum for payment routing + warranty carveout (4) devon_salesops set 1:1 call with distributor and SiliconLine today. If marketplace rejects bridging, escalate to partnerships leadership for exec exception.
arjun_eng: I'll scope alias mapping: 2 dev hours + 1 ops hour.
marta_finance: I'll have the numbers in 8 hours and a one-pager for Deal Desk.
lee_legal: Draft addendum ETA 5 hours, will include a clause limiting Redwood's tax liability and a 90-day sunset.
devon_salesops: I'll schedule the call and invite marketplace AM.
rachel_partnerships: Thanks all. Please post updates here. If marketplace final answer is no bridging, we need vendor to consider listing via reseller program instead. :phone:
